what: The 1px grid lines are drawn separately per cell — each cell’s bottom line draws left→right and its right line top→bottom in .9s power2.out (vertical delayed by .28s), while the board (look: frame) draws its top and left lines in 1.2s (vertical delayed by .4s). Fires once when a cell’s top edge reaches 88% of the screen. Sending fx:leave retracts them in .4s power2.in — a transition where the grid draws away as the page is left

options.look: If frame, it is the plate — handles the top and left lines, length 1.2 and delay .4. Default is the cell (bottom and right lines, .9 and .28)
options.lag: Seconds the vertical line lags behind the horizontal line
options.out: Duration of the pull-back on fx:leave (sec), default .4
options.hold: Waits while this class is on html — so the hero grid is laid out after the loader clears (e.g. is-intro)

from.where: All pages .sg-section (panel) · .sg-tile (cell) — drawn on entrance and withdrawn on exit

note: Use an element’s ::before and ::after as lines — for elements already using that slot, add a wrapper and attach them there. With reduced motion, the lines are fully drawn from the start
